$comment: pasted-label-ai-text-wire-schema-v1 (text route). The photo wire's shape plus one member on each value, unit, which the model fills only for a bare number (an empty string otherwise). No union-bearing parameters: absent values use the explicit string unknown, and an absent unit the empty string. The app maps it with pasted-label-ai-text-mapping-v1.

serving_size_text.description: Printed serving size line, or unknown

servings_per_pack_text.description: Printed servings per pack line, or unknown

parent_nutrient.description: Canonical nutrient of the parent row, or none

printed_text.description: Exactly as in the text, including comparator and unit

unit.description: Only for a bare number: the unit the text states for it in the row label or column header; otherwise an empty string
